items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: when they organized the Olympia band, he played with the band, he played with the band, and there was Tiet Rochon, Freddie Capard, Big Eye Louie, Eddie Vinson

ctx.x: I think Jimmy Brown did play with him later. He played with the ladies, yes.

Well, Jimmy Brown was with the Golden Rule until then when they organized the Olympia band, he played with the band, he played with the band, and there was Tiet Rochon, Freddie Capard, Big Eye Louie, Eddie Vinson, trombone, and I see who was playing the drummers. I'm trying to think who was playing the drum with them.
Mac Murray played in any of those bands? No, I don't think Mac.
